Case B: A manager labels a licensed technician as a pharmacist intern because the technician plans to enter pharmacy school next year.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A trainee may work without any Board license until the training is finished.

choice_analysis.C:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. CPhT 자격만으로 약사의 최종 검증 권한이 생기지 않는다.
교정된 설명: The pharmacist retains final dispensing validation responsibilities.
choice_analysis.D:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 직함 변경·입학 계획은 MA intern license를 대신하지 않는다.

Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.
